verses.text: A song of David, which he sang to the LORD about Cush from the tribe of Benjamin. LORD my God, I come to you for safety. Save me from everyone who is chasing me, and rescue me.
If you do not, they will tear me apart like a lion, ripping me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
LORD my God, if I have done this, if my hands have done wrong,
if I have done evil to someone who was at peace with me, or robbed my enemy for no reason,
then let my enemy chase me and catch me. Let him trample my life into the ground and leave my honour lying in the dust. Selah.
Get up, LORD, in your anger! Rise up against the fury of my enemies. Wake up and help me! You have commanded justice.
Let the people of the nations gather around you. Rule over them from on high.
The LORD judges the nations. Judge me, LORD, by how right I am and by my honesty.
Bring the evil of wicked people to an end, and make good people secure. You are the God who does right, and you test people's minds and hearts.
God is my shield. He saves those whose hearts are honest.
God is a fair judge. He is angry with evil every day.
If a person does not turn back from sin, God will sharpen his sword. He has bent and strung his bow.
He has prepared his deadly weapons. He has made his flaming arrows ready.
Look, the wicked person is pregnant with evil. He plans trouble and gives birth to lies.
He digs a hole, and then falls into the pit he made.
The trouble he causes comes back on him. His violence falls back on his own head.
I will thank the LORD because he does what is right. I will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
